field_groups.name: identity
field_groups.purpose: Preserve row/source/object identity across VL-SAT, Open3DSG, GT positives, and counterfactuals.

field_groups.name: obb_evidence
field_groups.purpose: Reuse existing semseg OBB geometry for distance, overlap, and vertical context.

field_groups.name: point_contact_evidence
field_groups.purpose: Estimate local near-contact and contact patch evidence from segmented points when available.

field_groups.name: surface_evidence
field_groups.purpose: Identify plausible wall, ceiling, furniture, fixture, or object-part attachment surfaces.

field_groups.name: gravity_and_contradiction
field_groups.purpose: Represent hanging plausibility and alternative floor/table support explanations.

field_groups.name: affordance_context
field_groups.purpose: Record class-pair plausibility only as context for later audit/ablation.

principles: Extractor emits evidence only; verifier emits satisfied/violated/uncertain later.
Object class affordance is optional context and must never be the sole proof.
Missing or ambiguous surface evidence should become partial/missing flags, not a hidden violation.
Exact predicate labels remain separate for recall; family grouping is only for evidence extraction.
